fields.label: Property Group
fields.description: Link to the global Property Group that owns this property's order, type and per-backend sync flags. Backfilled by the migration patch from the legacy property_name string. Take precedence over the legacy per-row fields once non-null.

fields.label: Property Name (legacy)
fields.description: Legacy free-text property name. Kept in lock-step with property_group during the migration window so a rollback stays possible; drop in a follow-up patch once the apply pipeline reads exclusively from property_group.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: Value of the property (can contain HTML for Custom Fields)

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Property = filterable in shop, Text = non-filterable product property (Technische Daten), Custom Field = product detail page only

fields.label: Data Type
fields.options:
text
html
boolean
number
select
datetime
fields.description: Data type for Custom Fields (used by Shopware and other integrations)

fields.label: Filterable
fields.description: Show as filter in shop frontend (only for Properties)

fields.label: Medusa
fields.description: Sync this property to Medusa as product metadata
